summary: [spec-fidelity] The retag atip.planjcs.11 -> canon-0-35-crate-plan.F1 is nominal. F1 is the digest of a Plan (sha256: + JCS of {effects,inputs}; failure path: a number outside the safe integers or a float is an error). atip.planjcs.11 proves that a 0.34-form digest (64 hex, no prefix) is PLAN_STALE on the six commands, which is the failure path of brief F3 (and atip.planjcs.02 already carries F3 for it). canon cannot observe F1's failure path at all: none of the six destructive commands takes an integer argument (checked canon purge/tier age help; every plan argument is text), so that path is crate-only, as atip-dep ruled. Fix: drop crate-plan.F1 from atip.planjcs.11 (tag crate-plan.F3 if a second F3 failure is wanted) and leave F1's failure path to the crate's own tests. I did not sign atip.planjcs.11; its own test passes. Blast radius: the brief check would count F1 as having a failure scenario that is really F3's.
